parsed.title: Inconsistent Census Enumeration
parsed.detail: The 'Scope' section (lines 114-125) enumerates eight skill files and six tutorial files for the destination census, but the 'Planning evidence' table (PE-007, line 175) and the 'P4' phase description (line 345) claim a wider census of 14 files (eight skills + three tutorial pairs * 2 languages). The 'Scope' list is under-inclusive compared to the actual validator and the convergence claim.
